fusions.name: Butting Haul
fusions.desc: A butting blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Through the Mail
fusions.desc: Swings a ring of strands, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Braced Tether
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Dug-In Heels
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
